name: Roofrunner’s Buckler
body:
Price 6,090 gp; Slot shield; CL 5th; Weight 5 lbs.; Aura faint evocation

DESCRIPTION

This +1 buckler has patchwork coloring and has a slight flare around its edges. By setting a roofrunner buckler down and speaking a command word, a creature weighing no more than 500 lbs. may step onto the buckler and, as a move action, hover across ground or open air, moving no more than 30 feet in one direction before it stops. The rider may stop the buckler and deactivate it as a free action before it reaches 30 feet, but once it moves 30 feet, it deactivates automatically and goes to the ground. Any creature on the buckler when it deactivates falls, unless affected by feather fall or other similar precaution. A roofrunner buckler must start on solid ground to be activated. A creature fighting while riding the buckler is unsteady, taking a -2 penalty to attack and damage rolls and AC. Casting a spell while riding the buckler requires a successful concentration check. The buckler cannot change directions mid-air; it must be deactivated and reactivated to pick a new direction.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 3,045 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells floating disk
